shots.line: In this town, every lie makes a yellow door. What's behind it? The truth.
When Mom saw her smashed clock, I said the cat did it.
A yellow door punched through the wall. Mom grabbed my wrist.
Whatever you hear, she said, don't open it.
The other me was inside, holding the hammer I'd hidden. Mom said he wasn't real.
Then every door in the hallway turned yellow. And every one of them knocked.
